en: Old monochrome postcard with a panoramic view of the city labeled Hermannstadt, showing church spires and town towers against distant hills. Printed caption and publisher credits appear on the front; handwritten German message overlays the lower margin. The reverse reads LEVELEZŐ-LAP and bears a pink Austrian stamp with a clear Wien postmark dated 15 Aug 99, plus an address written in German.
